liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **ween2008-07-08.mk41.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 31 songs; 172 min [1]
- **ween2008-07-08.core**: source not stated; 31 songs; 171 min [2]. Said about its sound: Recording captured at 24-bit 96kHz resolution before dithering to 16-bit [2]
- **ween2008-07-08.akg**: source not stated; 32 songs; 172 min [3]. Said about its sound: Mastered at 24-bit 48kHz before resampling to 16-bit 44.1kHz [3]
- **ween2008-07-08.Ca11**: source not stated; 31 songs; 170 min [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2008-07-08.mk41.flac16**: taped by Brian Porter; source: Schoeps mk41 (DIN) > kc5 > cmc6xt > Sonosax SX-M2 > Mytek 192 > Tascam HD-P2 (24/48) [1]
- **ween2008-07-08.core**: taped by Chris King; transferred by Chris King; source: Core Sound Mics/In Line Pre Amp> M-audio1 at 24/96 [2]
- **ween2008-07-08.akg**: taped by Chris Cage; transferred by Chris King and Nooch; source: AKG 483s 90 10dB cut Din >Oade T-Mod Edirol R4 mastered @ 24/48 [3]
- **ween2008-07-08.Ca11**: taped by Chris King; transferred by Chris King and Randy B; source: Church-Audio STC-11 stereo cardioid microphones > Church-Audio ST-9100 stereo microphone preamp > M-audio at 24/96 [4]. Also: Tracked, flaced, and seeded by RBayers after dithering to 16/44 WAV [4]
